g.text: In these experiments, graph overlap varies with the prompt and the answer.

text.style: font-size: 12px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #193747

g.text: On its own, it cannot certify correct factual processing or a representation independent of the answer.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #247867

g.text: Positive averages survive equal feature counts.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #8a522b

g.text: Facts recur across models; no model ranking.
Selected errors do not estimate failure frequency.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #8a522b

g.text: No causal circuit or proven error mechanism.
The fact remains linked to words and answers.
Near-zero does not establish absent knowledge.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #506774

g.text: Values are differences in Jaccard overlap, not percentages. n counts evaluation facts. Arrows connect evidence to interpretation, not causes.

text.style: font-size: 8.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #506774
